alto.name: Altostrat Media
alto.sum: Media company (podcasts, interviews, news, documentaries) adopting generative AI for personalization, natural-language interaction and self-service support. Reliability and cost management are the top priorities.
env: GKE for content management and delivery
Media library in Cloud Storage; BigQuery as the warehouse
Cloud Run functions for transcoding, metadata and recommendations
Legacy on-premises ingestion and archival, to be migrated
Google Identity plus third-party identity providers
Cloud Monitoring and Prometheus; alerts mostly by email
req: Reliable workflows across cloud and on-premises; simpler infrastructure; rapid deployment
Modern, centrally managed CI/CD; Kubernetes on-premises and in the cloud
Secure, high-performance hybrid connectivity for ingestion
Lower storage cost while staying highly available
Summaries, NLP and vision metadata, harmful-content filtering
Auditable, explainable AI; trend insights for content strategy

cym.name: Cymbal Retail
cym.sum: Fast-growing online retailer with a huge catalog. Three initiatives: generative-AI catalog enrichment, conversational commerce using Discovery AI, and stack modernization to cut manual work and costs.
env: A mix of on-premises and cloud systems
MySQL, SQL Server, Redis and MongoDB
Kubernetes clusters
SFTP file transfers and ETL batch jobs
Catalog search via SQL on product names and categories
IVR plus call-center agents who key in orders
Grafana, Nagios and Elastic for monitoring
req: Generate attributes that match the catalog taxonomy

ehr.name: EHR Healthcare
ehr.sum: Software-as-a-service electronic health records provider, growing fast and replacing its colocation facilities with Google Cloud. Needs scale, an updated DR plan and continuous deployment.
env: Several colocation facilities; one lease expiring
Containerized web apps on Kubernetes
MySQL, MS SQL Server, Redis and MongoDB
Legacy insurer integrations stay on-premises for now
Users in Microsoft Active Directory
Open-source monitoring; email alerts often ignored
req: Consistent container management, logging and alerting

km.name: KnightMotives Automotive
km.sum: Car maker modernizing the in-vehicle, buying and service experience with AI across all models. Wants reliable build-to-order, better dealer tools and revenue from data monetization.
env: Mostly on-premises, some apps on other clouds
Outdated mainframe supply chain and ERP
Dealers have no budget for new equipment
Fragmented vehicle code bases
Poor connectivity to plants and rural vehicles
Obsolete AI infrastructure and siloed data
req: Consistent AI-powered in-vehicle experience; rural connectivity
EU data protection; security after past breaches
Better build-to-order, dealer tools and CRM

AI Hypercomputer: GPUs and TPUs for training and serving, consumption models, large-scale training, Cloud Run functions and Agent Platform for AI workloads

Legislation and regulation (health records, children’s privacy, data privacy, ownership, sovereignty)
Testing and validation of software and infrastructure
Cost and resource optimization (CapEx and OpEx)
